title: Sonic the Hedgehog 2
shortDescription: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 helps define a Nintendo GameCube adventure and platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Frames a adventure and platformer catalog entry for source-aware Nintendo GameCube exploration.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Logged for the Nintendo GameCube adventure and platformer discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a catalog entry with its source kept explicit.
